mapper.insert: INSERT INTO metadata_table_relation (relation_code, main_table_code, slave_table_code, main_field_code, slave_field_code, relation_type, relation_name, description, business_code) VALUES (#{relationCode}, #{mainTableCode}, #{slaveTableCode}, #{mainFieldCode}, #{slaveFieldCode}, #{relationType}, #{relationName}, #{description}, #{businessCode})
mapper.update: UPDATE metadata_table_relation SET main_table_code = #{mainTableCode}, slave_table_code = #{slaveTableCode}, main_field_code = #{mainFieldCode}, slave_field_code = #{slaveFieldCode}, relation_type = #{relationType}, relation_name = #{relationName}, description = #{description} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM metadata_table_relation
WHERE business_code = #{businessCode}
